findings.summary: runner.ts: runLoop is a single function spanning ~740 lines with nested closures mutating outer-scope let variables; the same mutation pattern produced the CORR-STALE-DECISION-ID bug
runner.ts: consumedDecisionIds is a mutable string[] shared between outer loop and consultGatekeeper closure via .push() mutation, violating the project immutability rule
degradedMode.ts is 1242 lines, exceeding the 800-line file ceiling; mixes eight distinct responsibilities
reconciliation.ts is 1071 lines, exceeding the 800-line file ceiling
runner.ts: eight let mutable loop variables with no invariant documentation; degradedAttemptAuthorised flag is fragile across early-exit paths
gatekeeperTurn.ts: token estimation uses chars/4 heuristic with no documented precision bound; systematic undercount could bypass the budget admission port
system.ts: processRoot is a module-level mutable singleton with a test escape hatch; state bleeds between tests if resetProcessRootForTest is not called
runner.ts: duplicate JSDoc block for degradedContinuation closure; dead documentation from incomplete edit
verification.ts: gitLines silently returns [] on any git error, causing changedFiles to under-report in evidence records

reason, risks and carryForward fields from the gatekeeper response are written unsanitised to durable evidence records; bidi stripping is applied to nextClaudeInstruction but not to these audit-trail fields
Worker-writable findings and effects files flow into gatekeeper evidence; the implementer partially authors the evidence the reviewer reads (acknowledged architectural tension, not a decision bypass)
Heuristic redact() for check output may miss credentials in non-standard env var names; mitigated by scrubCredentials flag on child process environment
Lock file deletion failure leaves the admission lock permanently held; fails closed (denies calls) but requires manual intervention to recover
Cross-record reconciliation bypass was fixed (per-record matching), but test coverage of the specific cross-record scenario should be confirmed
nextClaudeInstruction content reaches Claude after sanitisation but with no semantic validation; boundary check is the effective structural control
gatekeeper.json budget fields (hardStopAtMicroUsd, warnAtMicroUsd) are read from working tree not committed git; an implementer could raise the ceiling without committing
